description: This file contains a test suite `GoldenPathLeaseProviderTestRunner` that verifies the functionality of an `ILeaseProvider` implementation, including acquiring, releasing, renewing leases, and handling error scenarios. It uses the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: GoldenPathLeaseProviderTestRunner
classes.description: A test class that provides methods to test the lease provider implementation for acquiring, releasing, renewing leases, and handling lease conflicts.

methods.name: ProviderCanAcquireLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can successfully acquire leases for a set of lease requests.

methods.name: ProviderCanReleaseLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can release previously acquired leases.

methods.name: ProviderCanRenewLeases
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider can renew existing leases.

methods.name: Provider_TryAcquireLeaseWhichBelongToOtherEntity_Return_LeaseNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests if the lease provider correctly handles attempts to acquire a lease already held by another entity, expecting a LeaseNotAvailable response.

methods.name: Provider_TryRenewLeaseWithWrongToken_Return_InvalidToken
methods.description: Verifies that renewing a lease with an incorrect token results in an InvalidToken response.

methods.name: Provider_LifeCycle_Acqurie_Renew_Release_ShouldBeAbleToAcquireLeaseOnTheSameResourceAfterRelease
methods.description: Ensures the lease provider allows acquiring the same lease resource after release, validating proper lease lifecycle handling.
